segments.say: How did the black queen end up checkmating on c1? Watch.
segments.caption: How did this happen?

segments.say: Against d4, Black throws a pawn away with e5. White takes.
segments.caption: Weird opening...

segments.say: White defends the pawn with bishop f4. Queen b4, check.
segments.caption: Queen check

segments.say: White attacks the queen with bishop c3. Black calmly plays bishop b4.
segments.caption: Pin!

segments.say: Queen d2. Bishop takes c3. Queen takes back. And queen c1. Checkmate.
segments.caption: Queen c1 mate

segments.say: The Englund Gambit trap. Would you have seen it coming?
segments.caption: Would you see it?

yt_title: The queen walks ALL the way to c1 👑 Englund Gambit trap #chess
desc:
The Englund Gambit trap: Black's queen goes deep into White's camp and delivers checkmate on c1.

The line: 1.d4 e5 2.dxe5 Nc6 3.Nf3 Qe7 4.Bf4 Qb4+ 5.Bd2 Qxb2 6.Bc3? Bb4 7.Qd2 Bxc3 8.Qxc3 Qc1#
